_goal: Wi-Fi off: say a happy English line -> a Bonsai-generated English reply (not a preset) appears and the companion turns happy; then a sad line -> a reply that follows the context and the companion turns sad.
_selectors: The page keeps these data-testid hooks: fake-input (text path for the utterance; voice goes through the same respond seam), reply (latest companion reply), companion (data-mood=<pleasant-high|pleasant-low|unpleasant-high|unpleasant-low|neutral>). Typed input stands in for voice because a script cannot speak into the mic.
